sources.flavour_definitions: https://kiwix.org/en/frequently-asked-questions/ (FAQ: "What do mini, nopic and maxi mean in the Wikipedia ZIM files?")

articleCount_evidence: libzim doc: getArticleCount() = all entries marked FRONT_ARTICLE at ZIM creation time; implementation returns the front-article index size when present, else the Counter text/html* total.
kiwix-tools #536 (2022): catalog articleCount=16,229,464 for wikipedia_en_all_maxi_2021-12 while M/Counter text/html=6,422,607.

NOMAD #1185 (maintainer measurement, wikipedia_en_all_maxi_2026-02): raw entries 27,199,904 = redirects 10,556,428 + non-html items 8,217,690 + isArticleEntry() 8,425,786; archive.articleCount 18,982,214 = 8,425,786 + 10,556,428.
My own read of that same ZIM's M/Counter (2026-10-01): text/html=8,425,786 (+1 text/html; charset=iso-8859-1) - identical to the maintainer figure; dirents 27,199,921.

flavours.mini: only the introduction of each article, plus the infobox; saves about 95% of space vs the full version
flavours.nopic: full articles, but no images; about 75% smaller than the full version
